info.title: RoslynConfigExporter - export configuration keys used by a .NET solution.
info.description: Exports configuration keys used by .NET applications using Roslyn semantic analysis.

options.name: --config
options.description: appsettings JSON file or directory; repeatable

options.name: --rules
options.description: JSON rules for external wrapper methods; repeatable

options.name: --fail-on-missing
options.description: Exit 3 when exact used keys are absent from supplied configs

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show help
Directory values passed to --config recursively include appsettings*.json.
